programs.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_rows = [r for r, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)}) == 1]

    def intervals(n, seps):
        cuts = [-1] + seps + [n]
        return [(cuts[i] + 1, cuts[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cuts) - 1) if cuts[i] + 1 < cuts[i + 1]]

    row_ranges = intervals(h, sep_rows)
    col_ranges = intervals(w, sep_cols)
    # The grid background is the most common non-separator color; the other color is the symbol.
    sep_colors = {grid[r][0] for r in sep_rows} | {grid[0][c] for c in sep_cols}
    from collections import Counter
    counts = Counter(grid[r][c] for r0, r1 in row_ranges for c0, c1 in col_ranges
                     for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] not in sep_colors)
    background = counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    scores = [[sum(grid[r][c] != background and grid[r][c] not in sep_colors
                   for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1))
               for c0, c1 in col_ranges] for r0, r1 in row_ranges]
    maximum = max(max(row) for row in scores)
    return [[int(v == maximum and v > 0) for v in row] for row in scores]
'''
p=programs/'task-efc51e9f.py'; p.write_text(code)
exec(compile(code, str(p), 'exec'), globals())
